title: qwen-reasoning and phi-mini are visible in the OpenAI-compatible API again
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: restored model discovery, clearer API docs, and a freshly curated creative-app showcase.

The OpenAI API model list now includes qwen-reasoning and phi-mini, so applications discovering available models through the endpoint can find and use them without guessing names or maintaining their own workaround list.

The API docs were reorganized into a more unified reference, making the route from simple HTTP call to generated text, images, audio, or video a little less archaeological.

Riffle joined the Creative Apps section while the project gallery received a small curation pass. The showcase remains a useful map of what people are actually building with the infrastructure.
